From gambit. I was part of the mod team back when the app was active, and I can honestly say it was one of the most rewarding experiences I’ve had. Over the years, a lot of different things happened behind the scenes some exciting, some challenging but through it all, the goal was always the same: to create a safe, welcoming space for people to share, connect, and grow.

Sadly, our developer reached a point where he could no longer continue supporting the app. It wasn’t for lack of love or effort he, along with everyone who worked on the app, cared deeply about it and gave it everything we had. We truly believed in what we were building.

I wish more than anything that it could make a comeback one day. It meant so much to so many people, and it breaks my heart to know that some of you lost your journals, memories, and entries when it closed. We tried our best to save and preserve as much as we could, but sometimes, even our best just isn’t enough.

To everyone who was part of the community thank you. Your stories, your kindness, and your trust made it all worthwhile. Even though the app may be gone, the connections, lessons, and memories we built together will always matter.

Was a nice app, sad to see how it was left.. I typically never write reviews for apps and I may be over sharing here for closure’s sake but opening up is sort of what this app was all about. Back in 2020 when I was around 17 or 18 and just mentally and emotionally at my lowest point from Anxiety and other aspects of life, I turned to this app for some potential solace and confide with others about the things that were tearing me up inside and to hopefully uplift others as well. For what it was worth, the community and people I had spoken to were genuinely lovely and a delight to speak with even in one off interactions and the venting and emotional calendars were neat as well. 

However, as my life began to change after high school I began to unintentionally grow more and more distant from the app and the community as my emotional and communication skills were underdeveloped (I’m still very flawed and it’s something I chastise myself for to this day) and I had sadly left it. I did remember this app recently and felt awful about how I left out of the blue like that and hoped to reach out to others still around. I was disappointed to find though that the app was seemingly abandoned and has stopped receiving any support and future updates. As I type this I’ve been stuck on the loading screen for a while with no way of logging in. I was expecting at the very least to see some sort of shut down announcement somewhere but just nothing as I noticed many others had dealt with the same issue months ago. Not writing this to call out any developer as I don’t know their situation but it’s still sad to see as right now it is seemingly unusable. 

My long and drawn out point being, as this app went by many names, Sup was a great means of creating community through supporting others going through it and find finding that same level of support through the wonderful people on here and it is a shame that this project was just left in the dust like this without any closure of its status. To those who I may have encountered on here, I hope y’all are doing great, living amazing lives and wish you nothing but the best and to those who took the time to read this review, I hope the same for you as well. :)

reviews.text:
Great concept, decent execution. **Since writing this review I have heard from the developer and they’ve simply had some server issues recently. My rating has been updated to 5 stars but I’m keeping the review because I believe it could be valuable feedback** 

I was really excited about this app when I first tried it. I loved the Vent and Let Go sections and the ability to receive anonymous support from real users. I was looking forward to becoming more involved in the community, giving and receiving support when needed. 

However at this point I’ve been locked out of the app for longer than I was using it. I thought at first that maybe this was just a temporary server problem, but it’s been a couple days and I still haven’t been able to load past the splash screen. I’ve been keeping an eye on the App Store reviews to see if maybe someone else would chime in with the same issue but that hasn’t happened recently. At this point I can only conclude that my account has been suspended. As far as I can tell I didn’t break any rules, but if I overlooked something and got banned because of it, then fine. There are other apps out there to use. However Im not sure if I’ve been suspended or not, because I haven’t heard back from the developer yet.

If nothing else, I want the developer to understand that banning without notice on an emotional support app isn’t cool. I’m an adult so I can handle the sudden cut-off, but despite this app’s age rating I came across dozens of users as young as 7 or 8 who were seeking support just like the older users. It’s arguably cruel to remove someone’s support network with no immediate warning, especially when they’re so young, may not realize why they’ve been banned, and can’t cope properly.

 I understand that certain subject matters can’t be discussed there, but there are less hostile ways to prevent some of these issues. You could have a filter function on the public forums where posts containing certain words are automatically removed. You could add a dialogue box that opens with the text input box reminding users what kind of content is unacceptable and what the consequences are. If you have to ban people, at the very least tell them why. Maybe consider a strike system. There are better ways to go about moderation besides instantly banning people with no explanation on presumably a first offense. 

But, again, I don’t know for sure if I’ve been banned because I can’t get a response from the developer anymore. Hopefully I get an answer soon.

Amazing! (+ some thoughts/issues). I’ve been away from Mood (and my phone in general) for a while but finally updated and opened the app for the first time in a while a few days ago. So I thought I should write a new review. First of all, Mood was always and continues to be an amazing app. I absolutely recommend it. The community here is lovely and incredibly supportive, as well.

Issues + Criticism (all incredibly small)
• One minor thing that I’ve also noticed is that the “space out” feature overrides any music I have playing. It would be nice if we could space out while still listening to our own music.
• Another is that we can’t add photos from our photo album to our journal entries. There is a camera option so that we can take pictures, but I usually journal at night once I’m already home and in bed, so I don’t really have any use for this method. I’d like to be able to add related photos or photos that I took during the day, though.
• There was an option to add later thoughts on our old journal entries, but this seems to have been removed. It looks like we can edit our entries though, but I’m not able to close the keyboard and save those changes? I’m not sure if this is an issue specific to my device or not.

A huge thank you to the developers. This app has made a huge difference in my life. It’s a safe space and a community that I’m so thankful for.
